title: One of the Hardest Hitting Webtoons Confirms Crunchyroll Anime Debut – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
Crunchyroll ’s plan to adapt more Korean webcomics, known as manhwa or webtoons, is also set to bring The Boxer by Jung Ji-Hoon (JH) to anime. The first look at the adaptation has been released, highlighting the hard-hitting action that the webtoon is known for. The announcement came during the recent New York Comic Con event, where the streaming platform revealed plans to adapt around 15 webtoons into anime in the future. Among them was The Boxer , with its announcement including a trailer, cast, and staff details. The anime will be brought to life through a partnership between Japanese studio Breccia and Korean studio STUDIO JEMI.

The anime will be co-directed by Takehiro Kubota and KANG Wonyeong, while Toshiya Ono will handle series composition and scripts, and Masahiro Suwa will design the characters. The revealed cast includes Koki Uchiyama as the protagonist Yu, Kensho Ono as Ryu, Tomokazu Seki as K, and Toshiyuki Toyonaga as J. These voice actors are known for their roles in popular anime, including Kaiju No. 8 and Jujutsu Kaisen . Crunchyroll has yet to reveal the anime’s release date , but its first look and hard-hitting narrative are already positioning it as one of the most intense anime to come, which could also revolutionize the pattern of webtoon anime adaptations.

Crunchyroll’s New Boxing Anime Will Expand the Industry’s Horizons

What makes the anime adaptation of The Boxer a significant step is how it could help manhwa adaptations move beyond the Solo Leveling -style anime. Ever since Solo Leveling received its anime adaptation, numerous Korean webcomics have followed suit, but many have relied on similar elements. This year alone has seen two such anime, Tomb Raider King and Overgeared . However, recent announcements of more webtoon adaptations suggest that the industry is expanding beyond this reputation, and The Boxer is solid proof of that.

The upcoming anime’s premise is what makes it so ambitious. It follows Yu, a 17-year-old high school student who embarks on a boxing journey while searching for meaning and emotion in life. The story sees K, a legendary boxing trainer searching for the next great fighter, discover Yu after witnessing him being bullied without reacting. However, K recognizes Yu’s hidden potential as a fighter, thanks to his superhuman reflexes, and decides that he could become the next boxing champion. Yu agrees to train under him, but only asks whether hurting others will be fun for him.

This sets the stage for a story in which the protagonist not only showcases his talent and rises through the ranks of the sport but also searches for something new and worthwhile to live for, discovering the passion that drives him. The trailer also highlights this element, alongside crisp animation that positions the series as one of the most visually striking modern anime about fighting. With a premise that bears some similarities to Hajime no Ippo , The Boxer could become its next major counterpart in the anime industry. Crunchyroll has yet to announce a release date for this hard-hitting adaptation of one of the most action-packed webtoons, but given its promising direction and visuals, fans may see it arrive by late 2027 or early 2028.

title: The Coppersmith's Bride Manga Ends in 3 Chapters
content:
Manga creator namo reported on social media last Friday that their manga The Coppersmith's Bride ( Cuprum no Hanayome ) will end in three chapters, including the upcoming chapter in this month's issue of Kadokawa 's Harta magazine on October 15. If there are no delays, the manga will end in December.

J-Novel Club is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Shiina, a freshman in college, is enjoying a cozy life in Niigata Prefecture dating her coppersmith boyfriend, Shuu. She's grown used to the rhythmic sound of his hammer, inwardly dubbing him the “smithing nut” for his obsession with hunkering down in the workshop, even on his days off. What she's not ready for is a sudden proposal out of nowhere! Barely out of high school, is she ready for the next step? And more importantly, can she really hack marrying into a prestigious smithing family?

The manga launched in Harta in May 2020. Kadokawa published the manga's eighth compiled book volume on May 15. J-Novel Club released the seventh volume in English on June 3. The manga is also available in English on Crunchyroll Manga.

title: The Heroic Tale of the Villainous Prince's Hirosaki Launches New Manga
content:
Writer Hare Tori and manga artist Hirosaki launched a new manga titled Saijaku Maō no Shinimodori Saiseitan (The Tale of the Rebirth of the Weakest Demon Lord and His Return by Death) in Hero's Inc. 's HERO'S Web (formerly Comiplex ) manga website on October 7.

The manga centers on Krom, the second Demon Lord who is weaker than even the Seven Demonic Generals who support the Demon Lord. In the midst of his reign, the Demons' mortal enemy, the Seven Heroes, invade the Demon territory and slaughter all, including the Generals and Krom's devoted servant Shia. In his deep shame, he commits suicide to join his companions in death. But he then awakens to a time one year before his death. Now wielding his own death as his greatest weapon, he prepares for the calamity that awaits him in one year's time.

Hirosaki previously drew a manga adaptation of Ryū Hidari 's The Heroic Tale of the Villainous Prince ( Akuyaku Ōji no Eiyūtan ) novels. The manga launched in Kadokawa 's KadoComi website under the Dengeki Comic Regulus label in July 2023, and ended in March 2025. Kadokawa published three compiled book volumes for the manga. Yen Press is publishing the manga in English, and released the third volume on July 28.

title: Junji Itō's 'The Hanging Balloons' Short Manga Gets Thai Film
content:
Toei announced on Tuesday that it and Thai production company 13 Studio are producing a feature-length, Thai-language film adaptation of Junji Itō's "Kubitsuri Kikyū" ("The Hanging Balloons") horror short story. Thai director Taweewat Wantha ( Death Whisperer 2 , Tha Rae: The Exorcist , upcoming film Dawn of Soengsang ) is directing the film.

Viz Media published the story in the Shiver : Junji Ito Selected Stories book under the title "Hanging Blimp" in 2017. Viz describes the story:

After an idol hangs herself, balloons bearing the faces of their destined victims appear in the sky…

The film project will shift the story's setting to Thailand, offering a new interpretation to the story, but respecting the original work's eerie worldview.

The short story debuted in Asahi Sonorama 's Monthly Halloween magazine in 1994. It inspired a Japanese live-action film adaptation in 2000, and the story was also part of the Netflix anime series Junji Ito Maniac: Japanese Tales of the Macabre , which premiered worldwide in January 2023.

Toei , Thai film studio M Studio , and South Korean production company Showbox announced in May that they are jointly producing a live-action film of another short story by Ito, " The Long Hair in the Attic " (" Yaneura no Nagai Kami "). Sitisiri Mongkolsiri ( The Red Line, Hunger, Inhuman Kiss ) is directing the project which will begin filming next year.

Pan-Asian film and entertainment studio Through the Lens Entertainment and horror brand Fangoria Studios are collaborating to produce films based on Ito's "The Mystery of the Haunted House" Parts 1 and 2, and "Bloodsucking Darkness."

Strange -Itō Junji no Yoru mo Nemurenu Kimyō na Hanashi- (Strange - Junji Ito 's Strange Stories for Sleepless Nights), a live-action omnibus series based on 13 manga stories by Ito, premiered on July 3 in the TV Tokyo channel's "Drama 24" programming block.

Ito's Uzumaki manga also inspired a four-episode anime mini-series that premiered on Toonami in September 2024.

Junji Ito "Collection" , a previous television anime of manga by Ito, adapted stories from the Itō Junji Kessaku-shū collection, as well as the Fragments of Horror book. The anime premiered in January 2018 and had 12 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the series with English subtitles as it aired in Japan, and Funimation streamed an English dub . The anime included an adaptation of Ito's Tomie story on its second and third DVD sets.

Ito's Uzumaki and Tomie manga have inspired live-action adaptations, and his Gyo manga inspired an original video anime project.

The Will Eisner Comic Industry Awards inducted Ito into the Will Eisner Comic Awards Hall of Fame in July 2025. Ito previously won Eisner Awards for Lovesickness , Remina , Venus In The Blind Spot , and " Frankenstein ." Comic-Con International in San Diego awarded its Inkpot Award to Ito in 2023. The Will Eisner Comic Industry Awards nominated Ito's Black Paradox manga for Best U.S. Edition of International Material—Asia in 2023.

title: Hirayasumi Anime Announces 5 More Cast Members
content:
The staff for the television anime of Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga (a co-production with Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions Co., Ltd and Production +h. ) announced five more cast members on Tuesday.

The newly announced cast members are (image above from left to right):

• Daisuke Namikawa as Hideki Noguchi, Hiroto's high school friend who now works in a trendy furniture store

• Yōko Hikasa as Yomogi Tachibana, a career woman who feels empty after doing nothing but work

• Yume Miyamoto as Akari Yokoyama, Natsumi's first-ever friend

• Yūichirō Umehara as Ryō Ishikawa, a novelist who is in a minor slump since his books don't sell like they did in his debut

• Japanese television announcer Yūko Naitō as Narrator

Viz describes the human drama story:

At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people around him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life.

The anime stars Yūma Uchida as Hiroto Ikuta, Mayu Takahashi as Natsumi Kobayashi and Rikako Aikawa as Hanae Wada.

Kei Suezawa ( Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot - Wandering: Agateram, FLCL Progressive ) is directing the anime at Production +h. Naoyuki Asano ( Urusei Yatsura , Keep Your Hands Off Eizouken! , Mr. Osomatsu ) is designing the characters. Mika Nishimura ( Dead Dead Demon's Dededede Destruction , Typhoon Noruda ) is the art director. Kaori Sawada ( What Did You Eat Yesterday? , When Spring Comes ) is composing the music.

The anime will premiere in January 2027 in Japan on the NHK General channel. Viz Media also announced an English release in 2027.

Viz Media and Japan Society hosted the world premiere screening of the first episode at Japan Society's location in New York City on October 7.

Shinzō launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine in April 2021. Shogakukan published the manga's 10th compiled book volume on April 30, and the series has over 1.1 million copies in circulation worldwide. The manga was nominated for the 15th Manga Taisho awards in January 2022, ranked #18 in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in December 2022, nominated for the 27th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in February 2023, and nominated for Best Continuing Manga Series in the 2nd American Manga Awards.

The series also inspired a live-action series , which premiered on NHK in November 2025.

Denpa has licensed Shinzō's Holiday Junction collection of short manga. The book contains seven one-shot manga. Shogakukan shipped the book in Japan in July 2016.

title: 'Hirayasumi' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Keigo Shinzou 's Hirayasumi manga announced five additional cast members on Tuesday. The anime series will premiere on NHK-G in January 2027.

Cast Hideki Noguchi: Daisuke Namikawa ( Hunter x Hunter (2011) ) Yomogi Tachibana: Youko Hikasa ( High School DxD ) Akari Yokoyama: Yume Miyamoto ( SSSS.Gridman ) Ryou Ishikawa: Yuuichirou Umehara ( Goblin Slayer ) Narrator: Yuuko Naitou

Kei Suezawa ( Fate/Grand Order: Shinsei Entaku Ryuoiki Camelot - Wandering; Agateram ) is directing the anime at Production +h and is also in charge of series composition and scriptwriting. Naoyuki Asano ( Eizouken ni wa Te wo Dasu na! ) is designing the characters, while Mika Nishimura ( Dead Dead Demons Dededede Destruction ) serving as the art director. Kaori Sawada ( Gakkougurashi! ending theme performance ) is composing the music.

Shinzou began drawing the slice of life manga in Big Comic Spirits magazine in April 2021. Shogakukan published the tenth volume on April 30. The manga is set to end in two more chapters.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in October 2023, with the ninth volume released on May 19.

Hirayasumi was nominated for the 15th and 17th Manga Taisho . The manga also placed among the top 20 titles in the male readers category in the 2023 Kono Manga ga Sugoi! rankings and MyAnimeList's 2024 edition of You Should Read This Manga . The series won the 71st Shogakukan Manga Award in 2026.

title: Attack on Titan Musical Starts World Tour in Singapore Next April
content:
Attack on Titan : The Musical , the stage musical based on Hajime Isayama 's Attack on Titan manga, announced on Tuesday that the musical will go on a world tour that will begin with a run at the Sands Theatre, Marina Bay Sands in Singapore from April 15 to May 2, 2027. The tour will announce more dates at a later time.

Gō Ueki directs the musical, while Masafumi Hata wrote the book. Hip hop artist KEN THE 390 is the music director, with lyrics by Kaori Miura . The musical combines traditional staging and music with technology to recreate the Attack on Titan world.

The musical first ran at the Orix Theater in Osaka and the Seinenkan Hall in Tokyo in January 2023. The musical held its first international performance at the New York City Center in New York in October 2024.

The manga inspired an earlier, planned stage play production in 2017, but that production was cancelled after 38-year-old acrobat Kazutaka Yoshino died due to an on-stage accident.

Hajime Isayama launched the original Attack on Titan manga in Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in 2009, and ended the series in April 2021. The manga's 34th and final compiled book volume shipped in June 2021. Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga in English digitally and in print, and released the 34th volume in October 2021.

The first television anime season premiered in April 2013, and the second season premiered in April 2017. The first part of the third season premiered in July 2018, and the second half premiered in April 2019. Attack on Titan The Final Season premiered on NHK in December 2020 and aired for 16 episodes. Attack on Titan The Final Season Part 2 premiered with episode 76 on the NHK General channel in January 2022, and aired for 12 episodes.

The Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS ( Shingeki no Kyojin The Final Season Kanketsu-hen ) Part 1 anime aired as a one-hour special in March 2023. The Part 2 anime aired in November 2023. Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS parts 1 and 2 also streamed in Japan in single-episode format, serving as episodes 88-94 of the anime. Toonami aired the anime beginning in January 2024.

Attack on Titan The Movie: THE LAST ATTACK , a compilation of Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS , opened in November 2024 for a three-week limited engagement in Japanese theaters.
author: ANN

contentBlocks.text: Attack on Titan : The Musical , the stage musical based on Hajime Isayama 's Attack on Titan manga, announced on Tuesday that the musical will go on a world tour that will begin with a run at the Sands Theatre, Marina Bay Sands in Singapore from April 15 to May 2, 2027. The tour will announce more dates at a later time.

contentBlocks.credit: Image via Attack on Titan: The Musical Facebook page

contentBlocks.text: Gō Ueki directs the musical, while Masafumi Hata wrote the book. Hip hop artist KEN THE 390 is the music director, with lyrics by Kaori Miura . The musical combines traditional staging and music with technology to recreate the Attack on Titan world.

The musical first ran at the Orix Theater in Osaka and the Seinenkan Hall in Tokyo in January 2023. The musical held its first international performance at the New York City Center in New York in October 2024.
The manga inspired an earlier, planned stage play production in 2017, but that production was cancelled after 38-year-old acrobat Kazutaka Yoshino died due to an on-stage accident.

Hajime Isayama launched the original Attack on Titan manga in Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in 2009, and ended the series in April 2021. The manga's 34th and final compiled book volume shipped in June 2021. Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga in English digitally and in print, and released the 34th volume in October 2021.

The first television anime season premiered in April 2013, and the second season premiered in April 2017. The first part of the third season premiered in July 2018, and the second half premiered in April 2019. Attack on Titan The Final Season premiered on NHK in December 2020 and aired for 16 episodes. Attack on Titan The Final Season Part 2 premiered with episode 76 on the NHK General channel in January 2022, and aired for 12 episodes.

The Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS ( Shingeki no Kyojin The Final Season Kanketsu-hen ) Part 1 anime aired as a one-hour special in March 2023. The Part 2 anime aired in November 2023. Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS parts 1 and 2 also streamed in Japan in single-episode format, serving as episodes 88-94 of the anime. Toonami aired the anime beginning in January 2024.
Attack on Titan The Movie: THE LAST ATTACK , a compilation of Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS , opened in November 2024 for a three-week limited engagement in Japanese theaters.

title: Voice Actress Manaka Iwami Announces Marriage
content:
Voice actress Manaka Iwami announced her marriage to a man outside of the industry and the birth of her first child on her official radio program on Tuesday.

"It's been a while, everyone. This is Manaka Iwami. I'd like to take a moment at the beginning of the program to share something important with all of you who have supported me. This is a personal matter, but I have gotten married and given birth to my first child. My partner is not affiliated with the entertainment industry," she said during the broadcast of Manaka Iwami no Radio Tekuteku.

In her written message , Iwami also expressed her gratitude to those who supported her throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, writing, "This is a personal matter, but I am pleased to announce that I have gotten married and given birth to my first child. As this was my first experience, I had some concerns, so I decided to make this announcement only after I had safely given birth and confirmed that both my child and I were doing well."

She continued by apologizing to those involved in her work for the inconvenience caused by her pregnancy and childbirth, while expressing her appreciation for their support. "The presence of all of you who enjoy the works I am involved in and, thankfully, support me as well is an irreplaceable treasure in my life. Thank you so much, always," she wrote.

Iwami graduated from the Pro-Fit Voice Actor Training School and began her voice acting career in 2016 under Pro-Fit. She made her first leading role appearance as Maquia in the Sayonara no Asa ni Yakusoku no Hana wo Kazarou . In 2019, she received the Best New Actress Award at the 13th Seiyuu Awards. In April 2022, following the closure of Pro-Fit's management division, she transferred to the agency Raccoon Dog. In March 2024, she received the Best Supporting Actress Award at the 18th Seiyuu Awards, following recognition for her performances as Akane Kurokawa in [Oshi no Ko] .

Iwami is best known for her roles as Tohru Honda in Fruits Basket , Rice Shower in Uma Musume: Pretty Derby , Mahiru Shiina in Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken , Umi Asanagi in Class de 2-banme ni Kawaii Onnanoko to Tomodachi ni Natta , Reirin Kou in Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den , and Euphyllia Magenta in Tensei Oujo to Tensai Reijou no Mahou Kakumei .

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Film's New Video Unveils Kajadan Pirates' Cast
content:
TOHO animation began streaming a character trailer for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming anime film based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, on Tuesday. The trailer highlights the Kajadan river pirates, and reveals the cast members for the group's leaders.

The newly announced cast members are ( Note: Character name Romanizations are not official ):

Kenshō Ono as Suija, the current head of the Kajadan, who searches for his late father Kaja's hidden treasure

Ryōta Takeuchi as Eishō, Suija's loyal subordinate

Jirō Saitō as Kaja, the former leader of the Kajadan who died a year ago, and left behind a hidden treasure

The film's website also presented a visual for Seisei, Suija's older sister and Kaja's daughter. Though the trailer also features the character, it did not announce her voice cast member.

TOHO animation will present one more character video tomorrow for Ruo Qing and Yi Shan (both name romanizations not confirmed).

The story follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to the hometown of a concubine who died five years ago in the imperial harem, to return her remains to her homeland. There, they encounter pirates, hidden treasures, the secret of the Empress' remains, and a mysterious boy who holds the key to the story.

The film will open in theaters in Japan on December 11 and feature a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . Mariya Ise joins the cast as key character and Bi clan son Mu Qing. Nobuo Tobita plays Bi clan head Birō. Kumiko Watanabe plays Birō's wife Shūu. Hirofumi Nojima plays the Bi clan's eldest son Bisen (all name romanizations not confirmed).

Crunchyroll announced on Thursday it has acquired the North American and worldwide rights (excluding Asia but including India) to the film. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will announce the release date at a later time.

The third television anime season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours . Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan and is also streaming an English dub .

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll is streaming the second season, and it is also streaming an English dub .

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print. Viz Media is releasing Minoji Kurata 's separate manga adaptation titled The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao’s Notes on the Inner Palace .
